lines: But then would the supreme tattva be
concept-form? Not so: the concept's work is done
no service or refutation of it for anyone.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nanu itthaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vikalpyarūpaṃ syāt maivam vikalpasya dvaitādhivāsabhaṅgamātre caritārthatvāt paraṃ tattvaṃ tu sarvatra sarvarūpatayā svaprakāśam eva iti na tatra vikalpaḥ kasyaicit upakriyāyai khaṇḍanāyai vā

reads_against.argmap: Is parama-tattva then concept-form? → Concept is soteriological tool, not metaphysical constituent: its work ends at dvaita-bhanga.
c1_essence: Concept is not paramārtha's form: its work is only dvaita-breaking; paramārtha is self-luminous everywhere.
reads_against.c1_rasa: karuṇā with vīrya weight (compassion carrying fierce argument)
